## History

Jerry is the hired boy at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) who assists with farm duties and chores. He is mentioned by [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) in discussions regarding work around the farm, including errands such as driving to [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody) or helping with domestic tasks.
